basic_details.job_title: IIT Kharagpur Junior Research Fellow (Education) Recruitment 2026 – Apply Online
basic_details.short_information: The Department of Education at the Indian Institute of Technology Kharagpur is hiring one Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research for a time-bound project sponsored by the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), on consolidated compensation of up to 37000 per month for 12 months or until the project ends, whichever is earlier. The essential qualification is a Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science, or a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, with selection through CSIR-UGC NET, GATE or the national level examinations the notice lists. qualification.details: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through a process described in any one of the following: | Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc.

how_to_apply: Apply online for Advertisement No. IIT/SRIC/R/QTM/2026/102 (Project Code – R/QTM) on or before 19 November 2026.
The application fee is shown as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

The notice states that the application fee is to be deposited through RTGS/NEFT/Net Banking etc. to this account: Bank name: State Bank of India (00202); Bank address: P.O: Kharagpur Technology, Dist: Midnapore, West Bengal-721302; Account name: IIT SRIC-OM Account; Account No.: 39502115210; IFSC Code: SBIN0000202; SWIFT Code: SBININBB339.
Mention the transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) in the Application Form.

content_sections.heading: Who Can Apply
content_sections.text: Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in Professional Course, selected through a process described in any one of the following: Scholars selected through National Eligibility Tests - CSIR-UGC NET including lectureship (Assistant Professorship) and GATE. The selection process through national level examinations conducted by Central Government Departments and their Agencies and Institutions such as DST, DBT, DAE, DOS, DRDO, MoE, ICAR, ICMR, IIT, IISc, IISER, NISER etc. Integrated B.S-M.S or B.Sc (3 years) M.Sc (2 years) in Chemistry or other relevant areas. The qualifications and experience prescribed are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview. Candidates should check the official notification for the discipline-specific eligibility of the post.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Tenure
content_sections.text: The consolidated compensation is up to 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience. The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier. The notice mentions no HRA or other allowance.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Research Fellow posts has IIT Kharagpur advertised?
faq.answer: The notice advertises 1 post of Junior Research Fellow (JRF) - Research in the Department of Education.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: The last date of application is 19 November 2026.

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the IIT Kharagpur JRF post?
faq.answer: A Post Graduate Degree in Basic Science OR a Graduate / Post Graduate Degree in a Professional Course, selected through CSIR-UGC NET (including lectureship) or GATE, or through national level examinations conducted by Central Government departments and their agencies and institutions listed in the notice.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 28 years, counted as on the last date of the advertisement. Age rules may be relaxed upon fulfilling sponsor agency rules if any.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of the JRF post?
faq.answer: The consolidated compensation is up to 37000 per month, depending on qualification and experience.

faq.question: Q6. Is there an application fee?
faq.answer: The fee is shown as 0 for General / Male / OBC, Female and SC/ST candidates.

faq.question: Q7. How do I apply?
faq.answer: Applications are invited online. The transaction details (UTR No./Transaction ID etc.) are to be mentioned in the Application Form.

faq.question: Q8. How long is the appointment?
faq.answer: The tenure is 12 months or the termination of the project, whichever is earlier, and the assignment is described as temporary.

faq.question: Q9. Does having the minimum qualification guarantee an interview call?
faq.answer: No. The notice says the prescribed qualifications and experience are the minimum, and mere possession of them does not entitle a candidate to be called for the interview.

faq.question: Q10. Which agency sponsors the project?
faq.answer: The sponsoring agency named in the notice is the Anusandhan National Research Foundation (ANRF), a statutory body created by an Act of Parliament - ANRF Act, 2023.
